description: The swift.org Swift toolchain in /usr, checked against the Swift release signing key, and the GTK 4, libadwaita and libsoup development packages ActionUI's Linux renderer builds against. For Debian 13 and Ubuntu 26.04 images. A box of it needs no network to build ActionUI's own packages; the add-ons fetch their dependencies from GitHub (--allow pack:github).

swift.description: The Swift release, e.g. 6.4.2 (ActionUI needs 6.3 or later)

platform.description: swift.org's build for this system, e.g. debian13-aarch64 or ubuntu26.04-aarch64; auto: the one named after this system

signed_by.description: Fingerprint of the key that must have signed the download: the Swift 6.x Release Signing Key, as listed on swift.org's install page

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the download, to pin it; empty: the signature is checked and the SHA-256 printed

steps.name: What the Swift toolchain links against, gpg, and the GTK, libadwaita and libsoup development packages
steps.run: apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 update && apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install --no-install-recommends binutils libc6-dev g++ libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libpython3-dev libsqlite3-0 libxml2-dev libncurses-dev libz3-dev pkg-config tzdata zlib1g-dev unzip gnupg git ca-certificates curl libgtk-4-dev libadwaita-1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libharfbuzz-dev libglib2.0-dev-bin glib-networking

steps.name: Swift from swift.org, checked against the release signing key

update.name: Newer development packages
update.run: apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 update && apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install --only-upgrade binutils libc6-dev g++ libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libpython3-dev libsqlite3-0 libxml2-dev libncurses-dev libz3-dev pkg-config tzdata zlib1g-dev gnupg libgtk-4-dev libadwaita-1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libharfbuzz-dev libglib2.0-dev-bin glib-networking
